citations.title: The clinical research workforce: a call to action for sustainability and competency development
citations.what_it_says: Maps SOCRA/ACRP certification against the Joint Task Force Core Competency Framework and documents certified coordinators' role in trial conduct rather than independent investigation.

citations.authors: Sonstein SA, Seltzer J, Li R, Silva H, Jones CT, Daemen E
citations.title: Harmonized core competency framework for the clinical research professional
citations.what_it_says: Defines the eight competency domains that SOCRA CCRP exams assess and shows the credential targets coordinator-level operational competency, not methodology depth.

citations.title: Occupational Outlook: Clinical Research Coordinators and Medical Scientists
citations.what_it_says: Reports CRC median wages (~$72K) and notes professional certification (SOCRA/ACRP) as commonly preferred by AMC and industry employers.

citations.title: Comparison of SOCRA and ACRP clinical research certifications
citations.what_it_says: Reports >25,000 active CCRP holders worldwide and outlines exam eligibility (2 years FT experience) demonstrating high accessibility relative to research degrees.
